_inspectorSnowReport.Report:
12/5  3:45PM-  Wow, what a day! Let’s do it all again tomorrow, but with even more terrain. That’s right, we’ll have 42 trails for you folks to ski and ride down, 30 of those trails will be taking on fresh stripes overnight. Alongside, 9 lifts will be spinning at 8:30AM, with no delays detected. Tyrolienne Park officially opens tomorrow with 6 features and 1 jump, go check it out!
The fun-filled weekend has landed with our Passholder Appreciation, our 1st Ikon Stoke event of the season, and the beginning of Kids’ Ski Free Week. Let’s go to Weekend Stratton. See y’all tomorrow. 

Our mountain operation team has expansion heavy on their minds. Snowmakers and our groomers are working around the clock to double our trail count for this weekend. Plus, we’re looking towards the weekend of December 13 & 14 as a potential opening for the Sun Bowl. Stay tuned for more updates!

Safety Tip: Stop in a safe place where others can see you! 

Kid’s Ski Free Week is BACK! Starting tomorrow, Saturday, December 6-12 skiers & riders under 17 can SKI FREE at Stratton! Whether you are first-timers or mini-pros, a free week of mountain fun is waiting. Don’t miss out on this fantastic week! 

We're kicking off the season right. This weekend, December 5-7, Stratton and Ikon passholders get the full treatment with après sessions, live music at Mid Mountain, fitness classes, and plenty more for the whole crew to enjoy. Check the Pass Holder Appreciation & Ikon Pass Stoke Event page for the complete lineup.

Want to go on an adventure of a lifetime? Well, you're in luck, our Guided Snowmobile Tours are back! Explore Stratton after hours with friends and family on a tour to the summit. Be sure to book your spot now to guarantee your spot.

The Nordic Center is now open for Snowshoeing! Enjoy a peaceful walk through 10km of trails with friends or family. Once more, snow lands, we’ll be chewing at the bit to get the Nordic Center up and running! 

First Tracks will be available for First Tracks pass holders today. Please call the First Tracks hotline for the most up-to-date information the day of at 802.297.INFO 

The last day to buy an Ikon pass is December 11. Buy Now before it’s too late! With 60+ destinations worldwide, you can explore winter to its fullest, from backyard missions to bucket list dreams.

Uphill travel is open! You must get a pass from guest services and read the policy online. Please keep in mind that there are designated travel routes with or without snow.

Time to lock in on your winter fun! Enroll in a high-performance adventure this season. This winter, accelerate your ability level through guided seasonal programs and specialty workshops with the Stratton Mountain Sports School. Seasonal Programs are the best way to turn your little one into a lifetime skier or snowboarder, with a strong foundation of skills, in a discipline they enjoy most. Seasonal Programs focus on fun at an early age, followed by specialty disciplines such as freestyle skiing and snowboarding, ski racing, freeriding, and more. These programs are offered for all ages, including adults, so it's never too late to join!

Stay and relish the Green Mountains! Stratton Real Estate is here to help with all your real estate needs. Make your sweet escape a reality.

Reliable cars are the name of the game; that is why we trust Oliver Subaru and Ford. Made for all seasons and all families, check out Oliver Ford and Oliver Subaru for year-round reliability!

_inspectorSnowReport.Report:
Good Morning Skiers and Riders! This is Eli with your 5 am snow report for Friday, December 5th. Remember the easiest way to get up to date information is on the Ikon Pass app or website.  

At Mid Mountain, we’ve had 2 new inches of snow in the past 24 hours, with 3 new inches falling at the Summit. All but a ¼ inche of that fell since the mountain closed yesterday. 

Our Mid mountain base is 11 inches, the temperature is 16 degrees, the winds are 3 miles per hour from the south, with partly cloudy skies. 

The Summit base is 15 inches, the temperature is 12 degrees, with calm winds under cloudy skies  

The base temperature is 20 degrees.  

The ops team has been working hard to get more terrain open, and today, that includes Lower High Noon and Sundown Express lift, meaning we will be skiing and riding on 6 lifts, 6 runs, and 84.2 acres on packed powder and machine made snow.  

After you’re done shredding for the day, head over for some live music at The Range Food & Drink Hall starting at 3:30. Grab your friends, sip on a drink, and enjoy some live music with friends.  

Stay in the know with the Ikon Pass App. Find it in the app store on your mobile device and get lift and trail statuses, conditions updates, and more.  

Ski and Ride with Care and we will see you on the mountain!

_inspectorSnowReport.Report:
December 5, 2:00 PM
The temps may be chill today, but the rope drops are red hot. Castlerock is officially open for hiking 11:00 AM - 3:00 PM, and we've also dropped ropes on Paradise, Ripcord, and Lower Ripcord among others. Please use caution on natural terrain, coverage is extremely thin with exposed elements. Base temps will be in the teens at the base and below ten at the summit, with wind chills well into the negative.  We're up to 34 trails covering over 140 skiable acres and 2400' vert. Groomers have added Lower Organgrinder and Domino Chute to the typical Jester/Murphy's/Heaven's Gate Traverse/Lower Jester/Gondolier route. Reminders that terrain continues to be for advanced skiers and riders only at this time and please be aware of thin conditions on natural trails. For beginners, First Time is now open for Ski and Ride Lessons, currently hike only.

And if all this good news has you dreaming of a visit, grab a TBD ticket for just $99 and ski any day during the 25/26 winter season. Purchases must be made before the end of the day, 12/5. Super Bravo Quad spins from 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM, and Heaven’s Gate Quad runs from 9:00 AM to 3:45 PM. Mt. Ellen hike park is back open today with 20 features, starting at 10:00 AM until 3:00 PM for passholders. Tomorrow we'll debut Gate House Quad and Welcome Mat paired with a handful of groomed trails. Plus, we'll begin opening Super Bravo and Heaven's Gate at 8:00 AM starting tomorrow.

Ready for more than turns? Join us Dec. 6th for live music with Soul Rebel Project at Castlerock Pub (1:30–4:30 PM). Starting Dec. 6th through Friday Dec. 12th, kids 12 and under ski and ride for free at Sugarbush. Whether your little ones are just starting out or already shredding, this is the perfect time to plan your trip to the mountain. Check out all of our winter events.

Have an Ikon Base Pass? Come ski before 12/25 and earn a voucher for an unrestricted lift ticket for yourself to be used any day here for the rest of the season. Grab up to five of these tickets simply by skiing and riding here before Christmas. Don't miss out on all of our deals including 50% off December lodging through December 26th.

As a reminder, please no uphill travel at this time, as mountain operations are ongoing at both mountains. We will announce uphill travel opening during the season when we have sufficient terrain to do so.

Bonjour Tremblant!

Winter is back in Tremblant! With the return of cold weather, the mountain is more spectacular than ever. Get ready for an exceptional experience—see you at the summit!

Some natural snow trails now offer the most authentic skiing experience, the progression park offers perfectly crafted modules, and outdoor enthusiasts can already enjoy alpine touring with 8 trails open to enjoy. 

Meet you on the slopes— the mountains are calling your name! 

Please also note that, due to ongoing snowmaking, conditions may vary and visibility is reduced in certain areas. We encourage you to exercise extra caution during your runs so you can fully enjoy your day on the mountain safely.

Stay warm and have a wondeful day!

 Mountain safety tip of the week: Please observe the signage.

Snow fall is recorded daily at 5 a.m from mid-mountain at North Side (550 m / 1,800 ft). This data, based on 24 hours, provides a picture of on-mountain conditions. Actual accumulation may differ from the official report. Be aware of changing conditions. Lifts and trails exist in a mountain environment and may close due to weather, usage and/or special maintenance.
